root_cause: The iGPU unit tests job (job_gpu_tests.yml, device=igpu, TEST_TYPE=unit) ran the ov_gpu_unit_tests binary (29286 parametrized gtest cases) and was still executing case 24843/29286 (~85% through) at 23:49:43Z, 80 minutes after the job started at 22:29:44Z - exactly the job's configured timeout-minutes: 80 cap. GitHub Actions reported 'context canceled' / 'The operation was canceled.', the classic signature of an enclosing timeout killing the step mid-suite rather than any application error (no gtest FAILED line, no crash). This PR only touches src/plugins/intel_npu/cmake/download_compiler_libs.cmake (an NPU compiler-libs download cmake script), which the GPU unit test binary does not exercise, so this is not a PR-introduced regression. Separately, the CPU functional tests job failed 4 cases of ScatterUpdateLayerCPUErrorConditionTest.ThrowsOnOutOfRangeIndices expecting an ov::Exception that the reference implementation no longer throws for out-of-range scatter indices - this is a pre-existing, already-tracked Code Issue (pattern e746e8e11c0fe156, a recurring pre-existing failure (3 prior occurrences) now also observed in this run), also unrelated to the NPU-only PR diff.
reproduction_steps: N/A for the iGPU timeout - requires running the full 29286-case ov_gpu_unit_tests binary on the same igpu self-hosted runner class and observing whether it approaches/exceeds 80 minutes. For the CPU scatter_update failures: build and run `ov_cpu_func_tests --gtest_filter=*ScatterUpdateGeneralPathOutOfRangeIndices*ThrowsOnOutOfRangeIndices*` locally against src/plugins/intel_cpu/tests/functional/custom/single_layer_tests/scatter_update.cpp:145.
recommended_actions: Re-run the iGPU unit tests job; a plain rerun is expected to pass since this was a timeout/cancellation, not a code defect, and the PR's NPU-only change does not touch the GPU plugin.

If GPU unit test runs are regularly approaching the 80-minute timeout-minutes limit in .github/workflows/job_gpu_tests.yml (line 42), raise the timeout or shard the ov_gpu_unit_tests binary (e.g., via --gtest_filter shards) to leave headroom.

Separately track and fix the pre-existing ScatterUpdateLayerCPUErrorConditionTest.ThrowsOnOutOfRangeIndices regression (pattern e746e8e11c0fe156, now observed again, 3 prior occurrences tracked): either the reference/CPU plugin needs to throw ov::Exception again for out-of-range scatter indices, or the test's expectation at scatter_update.cpp:145 needs updating to match current intended behavior.
Do not block this PR's merge on these two failures: neither is caused by the NPU cmake change being merged.
prevention_strategies: Monitor GPU unit test suite wall-clock duration over time and add slack or early sharding before the suite creeps past the configured timeout-minutes; a suite finishing near 85%+ of its time budget is an early warning sign before it starts intermittently timing out. For the ScatterUpdate Code Issue, prioritize a fix given it has recurred at least 3 times across unrelated PRs (#39833, #38825, plus the original) and resurfaced again on #39956, spanning nearly a month.
historical_context: The iGPU-job-timeout-near-the-80-minute-cap signature (75fb142987956bb4) was first recorded 2026-11-16 on PR #39742 (run 43866326044), where the same job was killed mid-suite at case 26049/29291 after ~77 minutes; this is now its 2nd occurrence. The ScatterUpdateLayerCPUErrorConditionTest.ThrowsOnOutOfRangeIndices failure (pattern e746e8e11c0fe156) has recurred 3 prior times (2026-10-23 run 40003582793, PR #38825; 2026-11-16 run 43897852365, PR #39833; 2026-11-17 run 44150712512, same PR #39956 earlier today) and reappeared again in this run, all on different PRs unrelated to the scatter_update code path, confirming it is a stable pre-existing defect rather than something newly introduced.
